The Senior Reconciliation Developer – Assistant Vice President (AVP / C12) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for the end-to-end design, development, configuration, and optimization of enterprise-grade data reconciliations and automated control pipelines.

Operating with a high level of technical autonomy, the incumbent drives reconciliation engineering across high-throughput transaction processing systems, general ledger architectures, and centralized data distribution platforms. The role serves as a key technical subject matter expert (SME) delivering robust risk controls, automated break classification logic, and scalable data pipelines for strategic initiatives including enterprise finance automation, Target Operating Model (TOM) expansion across Capital Markets, and mandatory control onboarding for 200+ critical application feeds.

Hybrid Schedule: 2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.

End-to-End Rule Build & Configuration: Design, build, test, and deploy complex multi-way matching algorithms, tolerance rules, and automated adjustment logic on enterprise reconciliation engines (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or proprietary enterprise matching engines).

Break Classification & Exception Handling: Engineer automated break classification and triage models to categorize discrepancies, assign break ownership, and accelerate root-cause analysis.

Scalable Data Pipeline Development: Develop and optimize high-throughput data extraction, transformation, and ingestion pipelines using Python (Advanced), SQL (Advanced), and Apache Spark / PySpark for large-scale financial and transactional datasets.

Technical Specification & BRD Translation: Partner with business analysts, operations teams, and product owners to translate Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) into detailed technical designs, data mapping specifications, and schema definitions.

Data Sourcing & Lineage Verification: Validate data integrity, provenance, and transformation logic from upstream Systems of Record (SoRs) into central data distribution hubs and analytical repositories.

Backlog Remediation Execution: Systematically analyze, develop, and deploy automated reconciliation solutions to clear active request backlogs (340+ scheduled and ad-hoc requests).

DevOps & Containerized Deployment: Package and deploy services utilizing Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms; maintain automated CI/CD build and test pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitLab).

Audit, Risk & Control Adherence: Ensure all built reconciliations satisfy internal audit, risk management, and regulatory control mandates as a required supervisory control mechanism.

Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the go-to technical authority on reconciliation logic, data schemas, and pipeline performance for peer developers, QA analysts, and business partners.

Stakeholder Alignment: Actively liaise with upstream data providers, downstream consumers, operations specialists, and enterprise architecture leads to resolve data friction and ensure delivery milestones are met.

* Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using **Apache Kafka** and **IBM MQ / JMS**.

* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

**Agile & DevOps Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics.

**Education & Experience**

* **10+ years** of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.
  

  

**Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies**

* **Core Java & Frameworks:** Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* **Spring Ecosystem:** Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* **API & Integration:** Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.
* **Messaging & Event Streaming:** Strong hands-on implementation experience with **Apache Kafka** (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (**IBM MQ / JMS**).
* **Database Engineering:** Relational: **Oracle DB** (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: **MongoDB** (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning).
* **Design Patterns & Clean Code:** Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

* **Business Process Management:** Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as **IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM**.

* **CI/CD & DevOps:** Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**
----------------------------------------
